title: French 政府 Calls Emergency 会议 与 平台 超过 Protests
content: TikTok 和 other sites 是 告诉 到 curb protest footage 和 AI-altered 图像,当 在线 retailers 像 Vinted 和 eBay reportedly signed 协议 停止 looted goods 从 flooding resale sites.
original_title: French Government Calls Emergency Meetings With Platforms Over Protests
original_content: TikTok and other sites were told to curb protest footage and AI-altered images, while online retailers like Vinted and eBay reportedly signed an agreement stop looted goods from flooding resale sites.
